caseStudies.title: Mapping 13 legacy nav items to 6 validated domains — from hypothesis to validated IA
caseStudies.summary: Three rounds of tree testing brought Jobs' Information Architecture from 67.1% task success (V1) to 97.8% (V3) with screened LinkedIn members. The 6-domain model now reflects how professionals actually reason — it is no longer a proposal.
caseStudies.businessImpact: Reduced IA ambiguity for member workflows, lowering training and navigation risk for product surfaces

caseStudies.title: Advisory Panel demo drove 12% increase in new orders in 10 days
caseStudies.summary: Showing 78 client members (55 banks) how their feedback was incorporated into the new Feed experience directly influenced purchasing decisions. Director of Product and Director of Dev confirmed the uplift was attributed to the panel demo.
caseStudies.businessImpact: Direct revenue attribution: 12% increase in new Feed orders in 10 days from client validation

caseStudies.title: Designing trust signals for AI-generated recommendations
caseStudies.summary: Research found users distrusted AI outputs without visible reasoning. Introduced confidence labels and source citations — approval rating improved from 34% to 71% in prototype testing.
caseStudies.businessImpact: Accelerated AI feature adoption by establishing trust patterns that reduced stakeholder hesitation

caseStudies.title: Stepper redesign based on drop-off pattern analysis
caseStudies.summary: Stakeholder interviews revealed step 4 of onboarding had a 40% drop-off. Redesigned as a single progressive form, reducing cognitive load. Client stakeholder sign-off achieved in sprint.
caseStudies.businessImpact: Prevented potential 40% user drop-off, protecting onboarding conversion rates
